definitions.explanation: The act of placing an order for goods or services with a supplier or manufacturer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発注|はっちゅう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I placed an order for parts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発注|はっちゅう}{書|しょ}→発注書：08069_hacchuusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧{発注|はっちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Since the inventory was running low, I placed an additional order.

notes:
{発注|はっちゅう} is a business term for placing an order with a supplier or manufacturer. More formal and specific than ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧, which covers general ordering including at restaurants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発注|はっちゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to place an order
- ⟦{発注|はっちゅう}{書|しょ}→発注書：08069_hacchuusho⟧: purchase order (document)
- {発注|はっちゅう}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: supplier, vendor
- ⟦{追加|ついか}→追加：04060_tsuika⟧{発注|はっちゅう}: additional order
- ⟦{大量|たいりょう}→大量：03112_tairyou⟧{発注|はっちゅう}: bulk order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧: general term for ordering (restaurants, online shopping, etc.)
- {発注|はっちゅう}: specifically placing orders with suppliers in a business context
- ⟦{受注|じゅちゅう}→受注：05133_juchuu⟧: receiving an order (the opposite side of the transaction)
